commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
  listado -e  C0_ANVL_EQUITIES_EOD | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -c Pc_Default_Equity -t 210000 -
else
  listado -e  C0_ANVL_EQUITIES_EOD | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -d $BusinessDate -c Pc_Default_Equity -t 210000 -
fi
jobDescription: This is a command execution job! It executes a script and possible has some parameters passed to it.
